description.text:
Operating within the core values and operating principals of the organization, provides real-time technical support and analysis for internal and external business users.
Responsible for receiving end-user support requests via phone or email based ticketing system, performing initial troubleshooting and root cause analysis, and accurately communicating as necessary to resolve issues in a global user community.
1.Responsible for the end-user IT requests in Aisa regions via ticketing system
2.Performing remote troubleshooting of hardware & software issues by connecting to end-users' devices in Asia region
3.Be able to use English communication for supporting Asia users in resolving IT technical issues
4.On-site troubleshooting of hardware issues including desktops, laptops and printers in Taiwan factory
5.Being familiar with network configuration in Taiwan factory and be able to promptly report network issues to the global network management team
6.In charge of Installation & configuration of hardware including desktops, laptops and printers
7.Identify and address users' technical issues, perform follow-up with users to guide and implement recommended solutions
8.Perform other duties as assigned
Temp position with opportunity to convert to permanent.
